description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - homework help for parents: photograph a homework problem (telephoto, memory only) and ASK sends it to the host language model as a data: URL image - the official read-text path, there is no OCR - for step-by-step tutoring in HINT mode (hints only, no final answer; a leaked answer line is quarantined behind a parent REVEAL tap) or FULL mode (worked steps, answer behind REVEAL). One step at a time, nod or NEXT to advance, MORE lets you dictate a question about the current step. Dictate-the-problem and built-in coaching prompts cover every failure. Nothing is stored; photos are never saved
name: homework-lens
